_note: M7 forest (P13, T19, crates/core/src/animals.rs): the forest's animals. Herds are placed once from the land's seed: herds of them where each kind lives ('edge': where the forest thins, a little out onto the open; 'forest': inside it) and one resting in each clearing without foes (data/places.json's forest.glades), of a kind drawn from glade_kinds. A herd stands when the player comes within wake_m of its home, if no more than most_near animals would then be standing, and is parked (taken out) past park_m. Each animal grazes (head down, graze_s), walks to a new spot within roam_m of home (walk_s), rests lying down (rest_pct of its pauses; always at first in a clearing), and runs from the player who comes within flee_m until it is calm_m away. None can be fought: they are not foes (SECOND-ORDER R9.446). Speeds are centimetres a second; a stride is stride_cm.
